actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multimodal identity evidence (EMT/DNA-repair-up, heme/fatty-acid-down RNA program; CDKN2A/9p loss with 20q gain; directionally consistent PBRM1 enrichment) and no set-level technical confounder association. Cross-modal structure is weak (near-zero fused silhouettes) but no positive evidence supports a reproducible split or merge, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation with residual structural uncertainty.

C0002 shows a coherent PBRM1-mutant/VHL-altered profile with distinctive CNV architecture (3p loss, depleted 14q/8p loss) and the strongest cross-modal support among sets (RNA, WSI, CNV concordant), with no set-level technical confounder association. Structural separation is modest but no positive evidence indicates a reproducible split or merge, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0003 is defined by a coherent and highly significant mutation profile (near-complete PBRM1 absence, marked VHL depletion) with no set-level technical confounder association. Support is essentially single-modality (WXS), so cross-modal coherence is limited, but no positive structural evidence supports a split or merge; the candidate is retained for downstream validation with this limitation noted.

C0004 has a coherent BAP1-enriched/PBRM1-depleted mutation profile with directionally supportive interferon-response RNA and the most reproducible internal structure (ARI 0.790, PAC 0.315). However, it is the only set with significant set-level technical associations (tissue source site, CT manufacturer, reconstruction kernel), a plausible competing explanation that warrants caution. No positive structural evidence supports a split or merge, so it is retained for downstream validation with this confounder caveat.
